genotype_structure_note: BABS alleles are heterozygous C-terminal gain-of-function variants, not HBB-style recessive genotypes and not equivalent to predicted LoF.
journey_status_note: Complete research-to-action path for established BABS (GoF): biology → GeneReviews/NORD → ICPD investigational DFMO asset → collaboration question. LoF disease association and cancer expression remain explicitly out of the established path.

diseases.label: Bachmann-Bupp syndrome (BABS)
diseases.genotype_scope: Heterozygous ODC1 C-terminal gain-of-function pathogenic variant
diseases.notes: Established germline monogenic disorder. Synonyms include ODC1-related neurodevelopmental disorder / NEDABA in some sources.

diseases.label: ODC1 loss-of-function neurologic association (unresolved)
diseases.notes: Not an established Mendelian disease entity here. GeneReviews states LoF is unclear / unlikely deleterious; G84R enrichment and activity claims remain unresolved.

representative_variants.experimental_effect: Elevated ODC protein and putrescine in patient cells; escape from normal C-terminal degradation (gain-of-function)
representative_variants.notes: Canonical BABS example: predicted truncation ≠ loss of enzyme activity; mechanism is accumulation of active enzyme.

representative_variants.hgvs_c: NM_002539.3 (C-terminal cluster; verify current HGVS on ClinVar)
representative_variants.notes: Second BABS allele example in C-terminal cluster (Rodan/OMIM). Keep transcript numbering explicit when citing.

representative_variants.predicted_consequence: missense; sometimes discussed as partial LoF
representative_variants.notes: NOT a BABS allele. Population-enriched variant with contested functional interpretation — unresolved disease association.

inclusion_criteria: Established BABS germline GoF evidence with public sources
Explicit unresolved LoF and cancer-expression caveats in review log
DFMO framed as investigational/compassionate-use, not regulatory approval for BABS
exclusion_criteria: Treating cancer ODC1 upregulation as the BABS monogenic mechanism
Claiming FDA approval of DFMO for BABS
Inferring BABS from any pLoF annotation
